name: serpapi-mcp
description: Official SerpApi MCP server for Google, Bing, and other search engines.
long_description:
Live, structured search results from SerpApi inside your MCP host: web, news, images, shopping, jobs, local businesses, flights, hotels, videos, scholar, app stores and more, across Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, YouTube, eBay, Amazon and other engines.

Every engine's parameters are exposed as MCP resources (`serpapi://engines`), results come back as JSON or token-efficient Markdown, and hosts that support MCP Apps get interactive table and dashboard views.

Requires a SerpApi API key: https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search any SerpApi engine (Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon, eBay and more) and return results as JSON or Markdown.

tools.name: search_table
tools.description: Render organic results as an interactive, sortable table (hosts with MCP Apps support).

tools.name: search_dashboard
tools.description: Render results as an interactive dashboard with metrics, a source chart and result details (hosts with MCP Apps support).

serpapi_api_key.title: SerpApi API Key
serpapi_api_key.description: Your SerpApi API key. Get one at https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key
